about: Captures whose visible-text hash differs from the capture before, read by the archivist and judged: 'same content' means the difference is how the page happened to render on that load (a menu not yet opened, a date not yet reformatted by the page's script), not what the source says. The hashes and the words that differ stay on the capture's page.

anepc/2026/11/11/0424-pt-avisos-a-popula.why: The notice's title, state (Ativo, 09.11.2026) and list of latest notices are identical; this load did not include the expanded site menu and footer that the 02:20 load had (5,100 against 1,253 characters of visible text).

ipma/2026/11/11/0424-pt-otempo-comunicad.why: The same communiqués and news items; in this load three news dates were printed in the script's raw form ('Tue Nov 10 08:00:00 UTC 2026') instead of '2026-11-10'.
